An employee is prohibited from humiliating or insulting anyone, including prisoners.[br/][br/]3.  An employee is obliged to notify all employees via radio if a prisoner is attempting to escape.[br/][br/]4.  An employee is prohibited from using obscene language (profanity).[br/][br/]5.  An employee is prohibited from using their authority for personal purposes.[br/][br/]6.  An employee is permitted to use weapons on the Penitentiary Service territory.[br/][br/]7.  An employee is permitted to attack a citizen first if that citizen is wanted.[br/][br/]8.  An employee has the right to ask any citizen to leave the building or the territory if they pose a threat. The employee has the right to attack first.[br/][br/]9.  An employee is obliged to obey the laws of the region, including other police officers or law enforcement agencies.[br/][br/]10.  An employee is obliged to obey the authorities that arrived to inspect the organization.[br/][br/]11.  An employee is prohibited from using an official vehicle for personal purposes.[br/][br/]12.  An employee is prohibited from being in the Casino, on the container yard territory, or on the gaming club territory while in uniform. Out of uniform, the employee has the right to do so.[br/][br/]13.  An employee is prohibited from using the organization's radio for non-work-related matters. This includes trying to sell any items, advertise businesses, and the like.[br/][br/]14.  An employee is prohibited from wearing accessories with the work uniform. Exception: sunglasses.[br/][br/]15.  An employee is prohibited from working side jobs or other jobs during working hours or while in work uniform.[br/][br/]16.  An employee has the right to sleep at work (AFK) in a specially designated room - the locker room. Sleeping in other places is prohibited.[br/][br/]17.  An employee is obliged to address citizens and colleagues strictly formally as "you", regardless of position held. This rule also applies to the government leadership.[br/][br/]18.  When using the radio of state organizations (department), it is necessary to use the prefix (Penitentiary Service) - (Organization). In the "Organization" field, you must specify the organization you are addressing.[br/][br/]19.  During formation it is necessary to obey the person conducting the formation, and it is also prohibited to use weapons and a phone.
